subject: POC gate criteria, owners, and exec readout — scheduling proposal
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@heliohealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-14 09:12 -0700
Subject: POC gate criteria, owners, and exec readout — scheduling proposal

Hi Lina — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have aligned expectations before we kick off the trial.

Summary of what you said you need (high level):
- Inference performance: 99th percentile latency < 250ms on standard queries and sustained throughput for 30 concurrent users.
- Safety/regulatory: audit logs + inability to persist PHI outside the VPC during the trial.
- Cost envelope: target token cost < $0.002/token average for the expected workload.
- UX: end-user latency under 400ms for the UI flows (end-to-end).

Draft success criteria (attached as poc_success_criteria_v1.pdf):
1) Latency: p99 request latency < 250ms for 95% of test set (owner: Ben).
2) Accuracy: top-1 intent match >= 92% on your annotated set (owner: Marissa).
3) Reliability: zero unplanned downtime, error rate < 0.5% (owner: Neha).
4) Security: KV cache never written to persistent store outside VPC; SOC2 checklist items X and Y verified (owner: Neha).

Proposed timeline (see helio_poc_timeline.xlsx):
- Week 0 (next week): environment setup + network allowlist + test dataset ingest (owners: Ben + Helio infra).
- Weeks 1–2: baseline run, tuning, and candidate quantization.
- Week 3: final evaluation and readout prep.
- Exec readout: propose 2027-05-25 or 2027-05-27 (30-minute slot) for go/no-go and next-contract conversation.

Decision process we suggest: internal Helio exec (Oliver + Lina) attend readout; Redwood exec (Marissa + Neha) present results; Helio does go/no-go and if green, Redwood to lay out contract path (SOW + pricing) and route DocuSign.

Can you confirm: 1) the owners on your side for infra and data (we assume Oliver infra, correct?), 2) which readout slot you prefer, and 3) any additional success metrics we should add?

Thanks — I attached the success criteria + timeline. I’ll loop Ben and Marissa into an internal kickoff once we confirm owners and readout slot.

—
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
From: Lina Torres <lina@heliohealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@heliohealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-14 11:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC gate criteria, owners, and exec readout — scheduling proposal

Neha — thanks for the clear notes and for putting the owners against the criteria. Quick answers:
- Confirmed: Oliver will be point for infra/network and will handle allowlist and VPC peering.
- Our data owner is myself for the annotated set; I’ll coordinate a secure upload by Tuesday.
- The success criteria look good; add one more: end-user feedback NPS target >= +40 on the pilot cohort (owner: Lina).

Readout preference: 2027-05-27 morning (preferred) but 05/25 afternoon could work if needed. Can you pencil 05/27 10:00–10:30 PT?

Also can you call out the required attendees from Redwood (titles helps with our calendar invite so execs know who will present)?

Thanks — Lina
Lina Torres
Head of Product, HelioHealth
lina@heliohealth.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Torres <lina@heliohealth.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@heliohealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-14 11:28 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: POC gate criteria, owners, and exec readout — scheduling proposal

Folks — forwarding Lina’s confirmations. TL;DR: Helio confirms owners (Oliver infra, Lina data), wants an additional NPS success metric, and prefers 2027-05-27 10:00 PT for exec readout.

Asks for Redwood:
- Ben: can you own the latency p99 validation and build the test harness for 30 concurrent users? We’ll run baseline next Monday.
- Marissa: can you lead the readout? We need a 20-minute demo + 10-minute exec Q&A. I’ll do the security and contract pathway briefing.
- Can we prepare a one-page readout slide (metrics: p99 latency, accuracy, error rate, NPS) and a recommended decision (go/no-go + contract next step)?

I’ll schedule the 05/27 10:00 PT slot tentatively and send a calendar invite to Lina and Oliver.

—
Neha
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Torres <lina@heliohealth.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@heliohealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-15 09:40 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: POC gate criteria, owners, and exec readout — scheduling proposal

Thanks — I’ll own the latency harness. Plan:
- Deliverable by 2027-05-17: test harness + synthetic load profile (30 concurrent users + burst profile).
- Baseline run 2027-05-18 morning; results posted to the Drive folder and included in the readout deck.
- I’ll instrument per-route tracing so we can show breakdowns (model inference vs network vs serialization).

If Oliver can confirm a stable allowlist by Monday morning, we’re good to go. Ben

Attachment: latency_test_plan.txt (stub)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina@heliohealth.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@heliohealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18 15:46 -07:00
Subject: Final confirmation: 05/27 10:00 PT exec readout + next-contract path

Lina / Oliver — quick confirmation and next-contract brief so calendars are clear.

Confirmed items:
- Exec readout: 2027-05-27 10:00–10:30 PT. Attendees: Lina (Helio Head of Product), Oliver (Helio infra), Marissa (Redwood VP Solutions), Neha (AE), Ben (Redwood Performance).
- POC success criteria updated: added NPS >= +40 (owner: Lina).
- Deliverables before readout: baseline report (Ben) by 05/18 EOD, readout deck (Marissa + Neha) by 05/24 EOD, security checklist + audit evidence (Neha) by 05/24 EOD.
- Decision process: Helio exec to declare go/no-go during the readout. If go, Redwood will (1) issue SOW + firm quote within 24 hours and (2) send DocuSign link for signature. If needs negotiation, we’ll schedule handoff to commercial lead.

Next steps (for Redwood):
- I’ll upload the readout template to the Drive link and share editing rights.
- Ben will upload baseline results to the Drive folder when complete.
- Marissa and I will meet Thurs to prep deck and identify the 3 highlight metrics to recommend a decision.

Thanks all — I’ll send the calendar invite and add the DocuSign placeholder to the notes so procurement sees the path.

—
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
